name: Ice cream
haveNote: Tap everything in your kitchen. Sugar, vanilla and salt are assumed.
foot: Freeze every pint flat for 24 hours. Crumbly? Press Re-Spin.
intro: Soft serve, scoops, sorbets and protein treats for the Ninja Swirl by CREAMi.

name: Juice
haveNote: Tap everything in your fridge and fruit bowl.
foot: Turn the juicer on before adding food. Cut pieces to about 2 inches, peel citrus, pit stone fruit. Black filter = less pulp, orange filter = lots of pulp. Drink within 24 hours.
intro: Cold-pressed juices, shots and mocktails for the Ninja NeverClog, searchable by benefit.

name: Blender
haveNote: Tap what you have. Salt, pepper and water are assumed.
foot: Load liquids first, then soft foods, then frozen fruit and ice. Never fill past halfway with hot liquids.
intro: Smoothies, bowls, frozen drinks, sauces, soups and batters for the Ninja Detect Power Blender Pro with BlendSense.

name: Grill & smoker
haveNote: Tap what's in the fridge. Salt, pepper and oil are assumed.
foot: Use a meat thermometer: chicken 165°F, ground beef 160°F, pork and fish 145°F. ½ cup of pellets is plenty for smoke.
intro: Grilled, smoked, air-crisped and baked recipes for the Ninja Woodfire Outdoor Grill & Smoker.
